title: The Peeker(horror)
description: Adds a creature that wont hurt just stalks and peeks at you from walls and ledges.
body:
The Peeker
This mod adds a strange creature that doesn’t attack, doesn’t speak, and doesn’t drop loot. It’s called The Peeker, and its only purpose is to watch.

It spawns randomly and very rarely—usually on ledges, behind walls, or in places where you wouldn’t expect anything to be. It has no legs, long skinny arms, and glowing eyes that stand out in the dark. You’ll spot it for a moment, and then it’s gone.

There’s no fight. No reward. Just a quiet, creepy presence that makes you wonder how long it’s been there.

The Peeker is perfect for players who enjoy subtle horror and atmospheric tension. It’s not about survival—it’s about the feeling that you’re never truly alone.

I recommend using the shader spookelementry with this mod it looks the best my opinion but insanity shaders looks pretty good too.

Needs geckolib.
